name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → /spec:run (design when due, then build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.134.0 — The mocks seed now names the client's real records and the two dense screens the theme pick judges every candidate on (ADR-0013): the seed's `## Records` section names one JSON file of at least three real records per entity, refused missing/short/invented at seed-done; `## Dense screens` accepts one or two declared labels (the singular `## Dense screen` heading still parses for hosts seeded earlier); and journey-drawn now warns per screen and refuses per journey when no drawn screen carries a value from those records, so a journey never reaches the client on placeholder data. 7.133.0 — Every seed journey edge is now a real, clickable control: the authoring session marks the element that leads to the next screen with data-to="<label>", journey-drawn refuses any seed edge with no such control or a data-to naming an undeclared screen (lib/mock-seed-checks.js's edgeGaps), and a mock served with ?walk injects walk-mode.browser.js so a click inside the frame reports where it went — to a declared screen or a miss — to the page that embeds it, the mechanism spec 03's journey player reads. 7.132.0 — ADR-0013: the client rehearses the journey. Direct landing of the sweep the record retires: candidate flows (specs/20260908/05) and the grid-in-client-mode draft (specs/20260907/11) are superseded, the dead variants:<j> stop routing is deleted from design-atlas.js and the review page header, ledger add/ask refuse --state so a question pins to a screen and never to a gray state, and the wireframe register moves from the flat zinc no-fills set to shadcn's Neutral component look on the same eleven roles (wire-tokens.css, wire.css, viewer.css value-equal) so a theme is a role re-valuation, never a redraw.
